pairs: Psalmus David.
A Psalm of David.
Domine,
O Lord,
quis habitabit in tabernaculo tuo?
who will dwell in your tabernacle?
aut quis requiescet in monte sancto tuo?
Or who will rest on your holy mountain?
Qui ingreditur sine macula,
He who walks without blemish
et operatur justitiam;
and who works justice.
qui loquitur veritatem in corde suo:
He who speaks the truth in his heart,
qui non egit dolum in lingua sua,
who has not acted deceitfully with his tongue,
nec fecit proximo suo malum,
and has not done evil to his neighbor,
et opprobrium non accepit adversus proximos suos.
and has not taken up a reproach against his neighbors.
Ad nihilum deductus est in conspectu ejus malignus;
In his sight,
timentes autem Dominum glorificat.
the malicious one has been reduced to nothing,
Qui jurat proximo suo,
but he glorifies those who fear the Lord.
et non decipit;
He who swears to his neighbor and does not deceive.
qui pecuniam suam non dedit ad usuram,
He who has not given his money in usury,
et munera super innocentem non accepit:
nor accepted bribes against the innocent.
qui facit hæc non movebitur in æternum.
He who does these things will be undisturbed for eternity.
